reviews.title: Add-ons don’t finish downloading
reviews.text: I’ve used you product for many years and purchased the all in one Add-on Bundle.  With this latest version update the bundle does not complete the Extended Solar System download.  This appears to keep all of the successfully downloaded add-ons from functioning.  I didn’t have this issue with the previous version.  I’m experiencing this on my iPhone and my MacBook.  With August 12 coming up, it would be nice to get the bundle working again.  I’ve installed, uninstalled.  Shut my phone down.  Restarted and installed again and am getting the incomplete download no matter what I do.

reviews.title: What an incredible waste
reviews.text: This used to be a good app. But they’ve put everything including the kitchen sink into it and now have made it impossible to do the basic. If I am looking at the night sky, what am I looking at. It used to be good at telling you. But now all I get are static images, like it has no idea where I’m looking. Among its hundreds of choices, none seem to do that. Don’t waste your money.

reviews.title: Just a great app!
reviews.text: I’ve been a loyal user for a long time. There are SO many times I am looking at a clear night sky and see something I want to identify (or test my knowledge), and this is my go-to. Lots of hiking nights, late MTB rides, out on our lake, or camping. It’s dependable, accurate, and just cool to use. And I don’t get too many of my friends to ask about it anymore, they have it too! A must get app for sure.

reviews.title: Nice, real nice
reviews.text: When that fast moving Cold Front has just moved through your area in the Winter and you live in a reasonably “Dark Sky” region of the country, the App is an ABSOLUTE MUST for finding those Stars and other Heavenly bodies on such a crystal clear night. reviews.title: Your “update” destroyed my workflow
reviews.text: I used your app to compare the sun and moon risings and settings.  It enabled me to plan my photography times.  It was easy to coordinate because the info was available on a single page.  After you “improved” update, I must now bounce back and forth between various pages to get the info I need.  Bring back the old format, please.

reviews.title: Great app so far
reviews.text: You have to make another $2.50 purchase immediately in to unlock everything, but it’s a one time fee so I’m good with that. Been great for helping me locate deep sky objects, though I’ve noticed a pretty prominent nebula was missing and the flame nebula doesn’t seem to be the right one. The missing nebula is the horse head nebula located right next to the flame nebula (basically side by side) but this is less of a complaint and more of something to fix if the devs want to. If you want to find the horse head nebula then literally just lock in on the flame nebula, trust me you’ll get it in there.

reviews.title: Horribly inaccurate
reviews.text: I've used this app for years and now it's completely inaccurate. I've double checked that my location and date are correct. It's saying the moon rises at 7am in NYC today, while SkySafari and Stellarium both correctly show that it rises at 10:42pm. If I hadn't double checked the other apps, I would have planned a moonless viewing night with friends and had it ruined by the moon
